critical_code_review_comments: LocationPage.jsx is 1563 lines - well over the 700-line soft limit. Recommend splitting page-data (all city objects) into a separate data module (e.g. src/data/locations.js) leaving only the React component in the page file. This is why content updates like 'Transparent milestone pricing' are being missed on individual entries.
Rating value is duplicated in many places (JSX stats, JSON-LD in public/index.html, JSON-LD in LocationPage.jsx, testimonials text). Extract to a single constant (SITE_STATS) to prevent drift.

aggregateRating.reviewCount in LocationPage.jsx uses pageData.stats[0].value (the projects-count stat, e.g. '45+') as review count - this is semantically wrong for SEO. Should be a fixed review count (70+).
